correctness.rationale: With inner product the equal-weight average on x_j=-1+2j/m, Gram–Schmidt basis {1,x,x²-μ2} gives μ2=(1+2h)/3 and variance 4(1-h)(1+2h)(1+3h)/45>0 (m>=2), hence exact quadratic endpoint kernel K_h(s). Its two real roots lie in [-1,1]; the maximal ℓ∞ input response is E_m=(m+1)^(-1)Σ|K_h(x_j)|=1 minus twice the kernel's negative-interval sum. Exact polynomial antiderivative/finite sum with fractional root lattice points gives the stated B2 and B3 Bernoulli-root formula, including m=2. Expanding smooth bulk yields C=1+12√6/25, first correction -54√6/(25m), and uniform second-order B2 phases with O(m^-3) thanks to global Lipschitz periodic B2. On m≡2 mod5 the two phases sum to an integer; B2 values coincide and irrational increment 5α+=(4+√6)/2 makes the attainable sum range [-1/6,1/3]. Thus the exact scaled accumulation interval is [227√6/50,377√6/50]. Independently compared rational moment/kernel values and Bernoulli formula at selected small grids; no finite test substitutes for density theorem.
